name: vidmuse
description: VidMuse motion-film plugin for Codex. /vidmuse-recut packages existing speaking footage; /vidmuse-create builds films without source footage. The bundled media-use dependency routes TTS, music, image, icon, avatar/video generation, ASR, and word alignment through the authenticated VidMuse CLI; ffmpeg handles deterministic local transforms. Shared taste stack (charter, tells, FRAME, gates). Ships HyperFrames core + GSAP domain references for composition; /hyperframes is not a product router.

interface.shortDescription: Recut speaking footage · Create without source · Multi-track Timeline
interface.longDescription: Dual product: /vidmuse-recut for existing talking-head packaging; /vidmuse-create for script+TTS explainers and website/product promos with no source plate. VidMuse CLI is the single AI media substrate for generation, ASR, and ATA; ffmpeg remains the deterministic local media tool. User preview uses vidmuse serve multi-track DSL. HyperFrames and GSAP are bundled composition references, not provider or environment prerequisites for media generation.

Director-mode recut of my interview into a launch-film motion piece
Make a 60s knowledge explainer from this script with TTS (vidmuse-create)
